studyMaterials.title: Introduction to Software Testing
studyMaterials.description: An academic lecture module by Assistant Professor Praveen Kumar (Patna Women's College) covering software testing foundations, verification versus validation, testing levels (Unit, Integration, System, Acceptance, Alpha/Beta), testing methods (Black-Box, White-Box, Grey-Box), non-functional testing domains, test documentation artifacts (Test Plans, Scenarios, Cases, Traceability Matrix), and automated test tools.

studyMaterials.title: Software Testing Principles and Practices

studyMaterials.title: Software Testing with Playwright
